messages:
Maya (design): Quick check on compact surfaces: proposing primary/ghost button visuals stay at 32px height to match dense table rows. Concern: touch hit area. Also noticed toasts sometimes block the table row actions because they render above the action strip. Proposing toast stack sits between toolbar (z=700) and modal overlay (z=1000), and non-interactive by default. Thoughts?

Jun (frontend): Visual +1. I worry less about visual mismatch and more about accidental clicks if hit area shrinks. Can we do an invisible padding hack?

Priya (a11y): Invisible padding is fine as long as the touch target is >=44px. If we use pseudo-element for hit area, ensure it doesn't break layout on keyboard-only focus. Also toasts: use aria-live="polite" and role="status". Do not move focus to toasts.

Noah (devex): Implementation plan: keep CSS height 32px, but add ::before with position:absolute to expand clickable area to 44px. That avoids layout shifts. For toasts: add CSS var `--z-toast: 850` and default `pointer-events: none`. Interactive variant will opt-in `pointer-events:auto` + tabindex=0.

Jun (frontend): Example snippet I can add to the UI lib:```css
.btn-compact { position: relative; height: 32px; }
.btn-compact::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -6px 0; /* expands vertically to 44px */ }
```

Maya (design): Nice. Also small copy tweak: CTA on empty state currently says "Try again" but we prefer "Retry" for concise microcopy across console. Will file a tiny copy PR.

Priya (a11y): On keyboard flow: when a toast appears above action strips, ensure Escape key still closes modals and doesn't dismiss toasts unexpectedly. Also interactive toasts must be reachable via keyboard order after the triggering action.

Noah (devex): Token churn note: Jun, we discussed renaming compact spacing tokens. Please add aliases instead of removing old names so downstream apps don't break. We'll flip the alias deprecation after one release.

Jun (frontend): Will add aliases in tokens.json and include a quick visual/regression test for table+button stacking. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1299 (WIP).

Maya (design): Plan: ship to staging, run visual tests + a11y checks, then one design + one a11y sign-off before merge. Thanks! :tada:
